messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: GPU capacity exhaustion in eu-west-1 (pool: inference-prod). Queue growth observed > 10k reqs, throttling triggered. Paging oncall-nyc and infra-jen.
oncall-nyc: seeing the alert, joining. any customer impact yet?
sasha: yes, a handful of high-traffic customers are reporting 503s. Dashboard shows sustained queue length and autoscaler not adding nodes, hitting scale_limit=20.
miguel: autoscaler logs show repeated failed node autoscale calls: `quotaExceeded` from cloud API. Also a bunch of driver Xid errors on several nodes.
arya: stack shows driver OOMs on 3 nodes, then node flaps -> many GPUs unavailable. That reduced effective capacity so autoscaler can't catch up.
infra-jen: copying logs from the autoscaler:
```
2026-03-15T18:45:12Z ERROR autoscaler: request to create instance failed: quotaExceeded
2026-03-15T18:45:22Z WARN autoscaler: backoff, retrying (attempt 3)
2026-03-15T18:46:03Z INFO scheduler: assigned 0/4 pods to new node (taint taints persisted)
```
oncall-nyc: can we temporarily raise scale_limit or provision a spare pool? I'm going to escalate to platform-admins.
ops-bot: note added to incident ticket INC-2026-318246: "Capacity constrained — investigating driver instability + quota limits"
sasha: mitigation plan: 1) reduce per-request batching to drop load 2) cordon and drain 2 flapping nodes to stop OOM cascade 3) request short-term quota bump from cloud 4) fallback routing to smaller model variants for affected customers.
miguel: running drain now on node gpu-node-7 and gpu-node-9. Drain logs:
```
kubectl drain gpu-node-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
pod/renderer-abc evicted
pod/tensor-worker-42 evicted
```
arya: while draining, I see kernel logs on gpu-node-9: repeated `CUDA: Xid 45` followed by `application killed: out-of-memory` — suggests a driver bug + memory leak under certain seq lengths.
infra-jen: submitted quota-bump request via console (ticket 982104). ETA uncertain. I'm also spinning a smaller reserved pool in us-east-1 as a temporary redirection target.
oncall-nyc: good. @sales-sam can you message affected customers with a short blurb and ETA? They need proactive comms.
sales-sam: on it. will send a DM now and a consolidated email in 15m.
sasha: meanwhile toggling workload routing to prefer model-1-small for non-enterprise tenants to reduce per-request GPU memory.
ops-bot: routing change applied: `route: inference-prod -> model-1-small (weight 0.6)`
oncall-nyc: any sign autoscaler resumes once we free GPUs?
miguel: after drains, effective GPU count rose slightly but autoscaler still hitting quota errors. Cloud returns 429/Quota until bump processed. Re-routing helped QPS drop ~30%.
arya: I'm collecting kernel traces to file an driver report. Quick snippet of `dmesg`:
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:01:00): 45, PID=9876: GPU TPC fault, killing process
[ 1234.568001] kernel: Killed process 9876 (tensor-worker) total-vm:12G
```
infra-jen: we have a short-term mitigation: enable aggressive preemption for batch jobs to keep interactive traffic flowing. Applying now.
oncall-nyc: applying SLA triage: mark high-tier customers as priority; shift their traffic to dedicated reserved pool in eu-west-1 if capacity available.
sasha: inventory check: reserved pool has 8 GPUs free, but driver versions differ; will test compatibility. If mismatch, we'll fallback to hosted model-1-small in a different region.
ops-bot: deploy-bot reports: `deploy/service-routing@release-203` rolled back on eu-west-1 (safety). No service deploys during incident window.
sales-sam: sent initial notice to customers: "We're aware of increased 503s impacting some endpoints in eu-west-1. Engineers are mitigating, routing lower-memory models and requesting quota increase. Will update in 15m."
oncall-nyc: OK keep pushing. @infra-jen can you file an urgent support case with cloud provider re: quota and mention driver instability causing node churn.
infra-jen: done. support case ID CP-77122. Also requesting accelerated review for temporary quota.
miguel: live metric: queue length fell from 11.2k -> 6.8k after routing + drains. 503s for priority customers dropped 80%.
arya: collecting stack traces and will open a driver bug with vendor, attaching `dmesg` and crash dumps. Also increasing eviction thresholds to avoid OOM kill loops.
sasha: next steps: 1) keep drains until kernel fix or node replacement 2) maintain routing to smaller models for non-priority 3) confirm quota bump or keep cross-region fallback 4) postmortem owner: sasha, timeline to publish in 48h.
oncall-nyc: handing off to infra-jen for overnight follow-up. oncall-nyc stays on watch for another hour.
infra-jen: taking handoff. will monitor quota ticket, driver bug, and node replacements. Please update incident channel with any customer escalations.
ops-bot: incident status updated: mitigation in-progress, customer impact reduced, severity -> sev2 (non-degraded critical paths partial). Logged actions and owners.
sales-sam: customers acknowledged; one enterprise asked for an SLA credit conversation. filed to CS queue.
oncall-nyc: thanks all. if anything resurges, re-pagering criteria: queue > 8k OR >5% priority 503s.
infra-jen: I'll post an update in 30m with quota outcome and node replacement plan.
sasha: end of thread for now — saving logs to INC-2026-318246 and will start postmortem draft.
